# Weekly Laboratory Plan

The course includes **12 planned weekly labs**. Lab 1 is implemented; the remaining labs are provisional plans and will be published with runnable MATLAB code as developed.

| Week | MATLAB lab | Intended output |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Vibration recording analysis and baseline classifier | plots, recording-wise split, metrics |
| 2 | Live IMU data acquisition | sensor stream and timing diagnostic |
| 3 | Signal filtering and feature engineering | window features and frequency plots |
| 4 | Classical machine learning for sensor data | classifier comparison |
| 5 | Deep learning for time-series data | trained compact network |
| 6 | Time-series anomaly detection | novelty scores and evaluation |
| 7 | Quantization and model compression | accuracy-versus-memory study |
| 8 | Supported MATLAB code generation | host-versus-generated tests |
| 9 | Nano 33 BLE Sense on-device inference | sensor + model + LED pipeline |
| 10 | Supported Raspberry Pi workflow | edge application |
| 11 | Memory, latency and energy benchmarking | performance report |
| 12 | End-to-end Embedded AI capstone | reproducibility package |

For each lab, record MATLAB/toolbox versions, operating system, hardware revision, sample rate, train/test separation, and any generated model/code versions.
